title: Andreessen Growth Parallel VII
archetype: Aggregate Fund-Level Cap Breach (ERISA 25% Rule) + Affinity CRM Prefill
investorTypes: US ERISA Benefit Plan Investors (single-employer and multiemployer pension plans)
US governmental plans (non-BPI, Similar Law reps)
GP and affiliate commitments (disregarded for the 25% test)
author: sarah.tran

outcome.summary: Smooth initial build: the ERISA aggregate breach surfaced in the 2025-07-22 dry run before any GP countersignature, and UAT sign-off and initial close both landed on plan.

incident: During dry-run onboarding on 2025-07-22, four US pension plans ($54.75M in total) were submitted through Affinity CRM prefill within six minutes. Validation checked only whether each LP was a Benefit Plan Investor, and each review packet projected 'approved book + this LP', so all four showed a green 19.69–21.24%. Together they took aggregate BPI commitments across Main + Parallel from 17.44% ($62.40M of $357.75M) to 28.40% ($117.15M of $412.50M), breaching the 25% limit that Addendum Section 6.4 requires the GP to manage across both Delaware partnerships. QA caught it before any GP countersignature.
rootCause: A fund-level ERISA constraint was implemented as a per-LP form rule, and the only aggregate figure excluded pending subscriptions and was not serialized, so concurrent submissions each read the 17.44% baseline before the others committed. Prefill v1.0 also mapped no ERISA fields from Affinity, so BPI status was unknown until each LP completed Schedule A.
resolution: Shipped 2025-07-25: erisa_aggregate_cap_guard.ts, a pre-countersignature webhook that locks the fund family, counts accepted and pending commitments across Main + Parallel (disregarding GP/affiliate interests), and returns ALLOW, WARN at 22.50% or HOLD at 25.00%, checking the aggregate and each vehicle. The fix also included affinity_prefill_mapping.json v1.1, which derives BPI class and weight from Affinity investor types, fails closed on unknowns and masks tax IDs. Under Section 6.4(d) the GP accepted Cedar Valley ($15.00M) and Northgate ($10.00M) in full, scaled Halvorsen from $12.50M to $5.00M and deferred Ironwood Ridge ($17.25M) to the second closing, giving 92.40 / 387.75 = 23.83% at initial close.
reusableRules: Implement fund-level caps such as the ERISA 25% test as a server-side check at GP acceptance across every vehicle the LPA aggregates, never as a per-LP form validation.

Count pending subscriptions and serialize evaluation with one lock per fund family taken before any read; in Postgres read at READ COMMITTED after the lock, because a REPEATABLE READ/SERIALIZABLE snapshot is taken at the lock statement.

Compute the per-entity regulatory test (29 C.F.R. §2510.3-101(f)) and any contractual aggregate together, disregard non-BPI GP/adviser/affiliate interests, and decide on the worst scope with exact integer arithmetic.
Classify BPIs at prefill from CRM investor types, keep governmental, non-electing church and non-US plans out of the numerator, fail closed on unknowns, and let the LP's Schedule A override the CRM.
Never prefill a full SSN or EIN from a CRM; bring only the masked last 4 and scrub CRM notes for TIN patterns.
Give the GP a soft threshold (22.50%) and the dollar headroom early so reject, scale-back or defer decisions happen before closing week.

artifacts.title: #deal-a16z-growth-vii: dry run hits a 28.40% aggregate BPI projection
artifacts.description: 2025-07-22 thread in which QA spots the 28.40% aggregate, counsel confirms the per-entity test plus the Section 6.4 aggregate covenant, and Sarah sketches the locked guard and the Affinity BPI mapping.

artifacts.title: Post-mortem: ERISA 25% aggregate cap breach across parallel vehicles
artifacts.description: Cross-fund BPI formula (numerator, denominator, exclusions, timing, concurrency) with worked numbers, the GP's Section 6.4(d) allocation down to 23.83%, and six reusable rules.

artifacts.title: Affinity → FundSub prefill mapping with ERISA BPI classification (v1.1)
artifacts.description: Maps Affinity investor type, entity type, masked tax ID, commitment and currency, accredited/QP hints and plan-asset fields to FundSub, derives the BPI weight read by the cap guard, and scrubs full TINs from CRM notes.

artifacts.title: ERISA aggregate cap guard (pre-countersignature webhook)
artifacts.description: Locks the fund family, measures BPI % across Main + Parallel and per vehicle from accepted and pending commitments, and returns ALLOW / WARN (22.50%) / HOLD (25.00%) with projectedPct, headroomUsd and reason. Idempotent per webhook delivery.
